messages:
jamal: Heads-up — proposing to apply a unique constraint on users.email next weekend. Need to coordinate the de-dup/backfill. Thinking Saturday 00:30-02:30 UTC in the low-traffic window. opinions? :thinking:
sasha: Are we doing a blocking index or concurrent? blocking at that scale will cause locks afaik.
maria: We should avoid a full-table exclusive lock. Plan I suggest:
```sql
-- 1) add normalized column
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN norm_email text;
-- 2) populate in batches and dedupe into staging table
-- 3) create unique index on staging then swap
```
This avoids holding a long exclusive lock.
jamal: That sounds safer. How long do you estimate step 2 (populate/dedupe) will take for 200M rows?
maria: Ballpark: with current batch job and 16 workers maybe ~6 hours if we run during offpeak. But we can parallelize more on dedicated pool. The actual constraint add via rename/swap should be seconds.
alex: If we need 6hrs of background work, can we start the population earlier (Friday night) and only do the final swap in the small Saturday window?
sasha: yes +1 to pre-populate. Need to ensure the workers don't saturate DB write IOPS. Can we throttle?
maria: We'll run the batch with p95 rate limiter. Job config below:
```yaml
batch_workers: 24
batch_size: 1000
throttle_qps: 2000
resume_on_fail: true
checkpoint_interval: 5m
```
jamal: Great. Regarding failure modes: if we see a surge during the swap, can we rollback? What's the rollback plan?
maria: Swap is rename of index/table and update of constraint pointer. If the swap fails, we abort and keep legacy index. We will have a one-click rollback playbook and pre-tested dbsave snapshots.
deploy-bot: Deployment pipeline scheduled: migration-job (prepopulate) -> staging-verify -> scheduled-swap (00:30 UTC) -> deploy-service (post-swap rollout). Watch for failures. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/1854321000
sasha: One more: pin the service image at the migration change so no simultaneous schema-dependent deploy happens. Devs: no schema-affecting deploys between 00:00-03:00 UTC.
jamal: I'll send a release note and put the freeze on the calendar. Also adding oncall rotation: @sasha on primary, @maria backup.
alex: We'll add query plans/monitors and a quick rollback query list in the runbook. Also watch replica lag during big writes.
maria: I'll run a rehearsal in staging tomorrow at 03:00 with a scaled dataset and post results here.
jamal: thanks all. I'll open the release PR and the calendar invite. :rocket:
